limits: One two-dimensional slice of parameter space. Actual full-network evaluations on a fixed training subset, not held-out data. No retraining, synthetic roughness, or smoothing.
title: Local normalized weight plane
method: theta(alpha,beta) = theta_final + alpha*d1 + beta*d2. Seed 42; each direction row matches its trained filter norm; orthogonal per-filter directions; biases fixed. Alpha and beta span [-0.5, 0.5].
